subject: reasoning
question: Six friends Alex, Brad, Charlie, David, Eric, and Frank are sitting around a circular table facing away from the center. Alex is sitting to the immediate right of Brad. Frank sits exactly between Charlie and David. Charlie sits to the immediate right of Eric. Who sits to the immediate right of David?
solution:
**Given:** Six friends Alex, Brad, Charlie, David, Eric, and Frank are sitting around a circular table facing away from the center. 

1) Charlie sits to the immediate right of Eric.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77f825768f432e06a5b6fe7212fda98bc03c73d533d41da5464598f270e37d93.png]
